lines.text: David was glad to go to the house of the LORD, and their feet stood in Jerusalem's gates.
Jerusalem is a united city where the tribes go up to give thanks to the LORD's name.
David says to pray for Jerusalem's peace, with prosperity for those who love it and peace within its walls.
David says "Peace be within you" for his brothers and friends, and seeks prosperity for the LORD's law.

wrong_details.true: the house of the LORD our God
